verses.sloka: स ताम् परिषदम् कृत्स्नाम् समीक्ष्य समितिम्जयः ।प्रबोधयामास तदा प्रहस्तम् वाहिनीपतिम् ॥६-१२-१॥।।
verses.transliteration: sa tām pariṣadam kṛtsnām samīkṣya samitimjayaḥ ।prabodhayāmāsa tadā prahastam vāhinīpatim ॥6-12-1॥।।

translations.english: Then Ravana who is victorious in wars, looking at the vast assembly (of Rakshasas) ordered Prahastha, the chief of the army.
translations.hindi: युद्धकाश्ड का ग्यारहवाँ सगं पूरा हुआ । म. ल्न द्वादशः सः fe ८ “४ स तां परिषद कुस्मा समीच्य समितञ्जयः । प्रचोदयामास तदा प्रहरत राहिनीपतिस्‌

verses.sloka: सेनापते यथा ते स्युः कृतविद्याश्चतुर्विधाः ।योधा नगररक्षायाम् तथा व्यादेष्टुमर्हसि ॥६-१२-२॥।।
verses.transliteration: senāpate yathā te syuḥ kṛtavidyāścaturvidhāḥ ।yodhā nagararakṣāyām tathā vyādeṣṭumarhasi ॥6-12-2॥।।

translations.english: "O Chief of the army You order those who are well versed in the knowledge of all kinds of war and entrust those warriors of four divisions of the army to safeguard the city. Likewise, you ought to order them to be more alert."

verses.sloka: स प्रहस्तः प्रतीतात्मा चिकीर्षन् राजशासनम् ।विनिक्षिपद् बलम् सर्वम् बहिरन्तश्च मन्दिरे ॥६-१२-३॥।।
verses.transliteration: sa prahastaḥ pratītātmā cikīrṣan rājaśāsanam ।vinikṣipad balam sarvam bahirantaśca mandire ॥6-12-3॥।।

translations.english: Celebrated Prahastha desiring to carry out the king's order assigned the army inside and outside the city.
translations.hindi: स्त ने रावण के आज्ञानुसार यथा- । नगर की रक्षा के लिए आकर सभा में रावण क तब सावधानचित्त मर्‌ विधान सैनिकों को नियुक्त कर [दया लग अलग सेना नियत कर, किर सामने बैठ गया आर यह बोला

verses.sloka: ततो विनिक्षिप्य बलम् सर्वम् नगरगुप्तये ।प्रहस्तः प्रमुखे राज्ञो निषसाद जगाद च ॥६-१२-४॥।।
verses.transliteration: tato vinikṣipya balam sarvam nagaraguptaye ।prahastaḥ pramukhe rājño niṣasāda jagāda ca ॥6-12-4॥।।

translations.english: There after Prahastha, having assigned the army for guarding the city, sat down in front of the king, and appealed.

verses.sloka: विहितम् बहिरन्तश्च बलम् बलवतस्तव ।कुरुष्वाविमनाः क्षिप्रम् यदभिप्रेतमस्ति ते ॥६-१२-५॥।।
verses.transliteration: vihitam bahirantaśca balam balavatastava ।kuruṣvāvimanāḥ kṣipram yadabhipretamasti te ॥6-12-5॥।।

translations.english: "You are a powerful one. Your army has been posted outside as well as inside. You may tell me at once without any distraction what you intend to do."
translations.hindi: सने तुम्हारी आज्ञानुसार नगर के वाहिर ओर भीतर चलः वान्‌ सेना नियत कर दी है। अब तुम्हारी जो इच्छा हो सो तुम | स्वध्थ मन से करों

verses.sloka: प्रहस्तस्य वचः श्रुत्वा राजा राज्यहितैषिणः ।सुखेप्सुः सुहृदाम् मध्ये व्याजहार स रावणः ॥६-१२-६॥।।
verses.transliteration: prahastasya vacaḥ śrutvā rājā rājyahitaiṣiṇaḥ ।sukhepsuḥ suhṛdām madhye vyājahāra sa rāvaṇaḥ ॥6-12-6॥।।

translations.english: Ravana who was keen on doing good to the kingdom desiring happiness and having heard Prahastha's word, said this in the midst of his dear ones.
translations.hindi: ससोमग्रहनक्षत्रमरुड्धारिव वासवः । भवड्धिरहमत्यथं बृतः श्रियमवाप्नुयास्‌ ॥ & ॥ इन्द्र, जिस प्रकार चन्द्रमा, ग्रह, नक्षत्र और मरुद्गणां से सेत्रित हो कर, स्वर्गसुख भोगा करते हैं, उसी प्रकार मैं आप लोगों के साथ लङ्कापुरी का राज्य करता हूँ

verses.sloka: प्रियाप्रिये सुख दुःखम् लाभालाभे सिताहिते ।धर्मकामार्थकृच्च्रेषु यूयमार्हथ वेदितुम् ॥६-१२-७॥।।
verses.transliteration: priyāpriye sukha duḥkham lābhālābhe sitāhite ।dharmakāmārthakṛccreṣu yūyamārhatha veditum ॥6-12-7॥।।

translations.english: "When there is doubt about dharma, artha and kama, you are capable of deciphering between desirable and undesirable, happiness and sorrow, gain and loss."
translations.hindi: भाइयो ! विपत्ति में, प्रिय अप्रिय, सुख दुःख, हानि लाभ हिताहित तथा धर्साथ काम की सब बातें तुम लोग जानते हो

verses.sloka: सर्वकृत्यानि युष्माभिः समारब्धनि सर्वदा ।मन्त्रकर्मनियुक्तानि न जातु विफलानि मे ॥६-१२-८॥।।
verses.transliteration: sarvakṛtyāni yuṣmābhiḥ samārabdhani sarvadā ।mantrakarmaniyuktāni na jātu viphalāni me ॥6-12-8॥।।

translations.english: "The actions carried out by me are always after it is well thought out and decided by all of you. I know that those actions have not failed."
translations.hindi: तुम आपस में परामश कर और एकमत हो जो काम करते हो, चह कभी निष्फल नहीं होता । क्योंकि सैं भी कई काम तुम लोगों को सम्मति से पूरे कर चक्रा हैँ

verses.sloka: ससोमग्रहनक्षत्रैर्मरुद्भिरिव वासवः ।भवद्भिरहमत्यर्थम् वृतः श्रियमवाप्नुयाम् ॥६-१२-९॥।।
verses.transliteration: sasomagrahanakṣatrairmarudbhiriva vāsavaḥ ।bhavadbhirahamatyartham vṛtaḥ śriyamavāpnuyām ॥6-12-9॥।।

translations.english: "Just as Indra who rules over the moon, sun, stars, and gods attains fortune, accompanied by you I will attain fortune exceedingly at once."

verses.sloka: अहम् तु खलु सर्वन्वः समर्थयुतुमुद्यतः ।कुमभकर्णस्य तु स्वप्नान्नेममर्थमचोदयम् ॥६-१२-१०॥।।
verses.transliteration: aham tu khalu sarvanvaḥ samarthayutumudyataḥ ।kumabhakarṇasya tu svapnānnemamarthamacodayam ॥6-12-10॥।।

translations.english: "Indeed, rightly I told all of you earlier. Since Kumbhakarna was sleeping I had not informed him about this matter."
translations.hindi: मैं सब प्रकार के कायो को आप लोगों को सूचित कर देना सदा से आवश्यक समभता रहा हूँ । परन्तु कुम्मकर्ण की निद्रा के कारण में इसे आप सब के. सामने अब तक प्रकट करने का अवसर प्राप्त न कर सका। यह महाबली कुम्भकण जो सव शास्त्रवारियो में श्रेष्ठ है, छःमास बाद अब सो कर जागा है

verses.sloka: अयम् हि सुप्तः ष्ण्मासान् कुम्भकर्णो महाबलः ।सर्वशस्त्रभृतम् मुख्यः स इदानीम् समुत्थितः ॥६-१२-११॥।।
verses.transliteration: ayam hi suptaḥ ṣṇmāsān kumbhakarṇo mahābalaḥ ।sarvaśastrabhṛtam mukhyaḥ sa idānīm samutthitaḥ ॥6-12-11॥।।

translations.english: "Kumbhakarna, the foremost among the wielders of weapons, is very strong. He was sleeping these six months and has arrived now."

verses.sloka: इयम् च दण्डकारण्Yआद्रामस्य महिषी प्रिया ।रक्षोभिश्चरितोद्देशादानीता जनकात्मजा ॥६-१२-१२॥।।
verses.transliteration: iyam ca daṇḍakāraṇYādrāmasya mahiṣī priyā ।rakṣobhiścaritoddeśādānītā janakātmajā ॥6-12-12॥।।

translations.english: "This Sita, the consort of Rama was brought from D and akaranya, a place where rakshasas wander."
translations.hindi: बह बात जो मैं आप लोगों के सामने प्रकट करना चाहता था यह है. कि) जनक की पुत्री और राम को प्यारी पटरानी सीता को मैं दण्डकबन में जनस्थान से ले आया था

verses.sloka: सा मे न शय्यामारोढुमिच्चत्यलसगामिनी ।त्रिषुलोकेषु चान्या मे न सीतासदृशी मता ॥६-१२-१३॥।।
verses.transliteration: sā me na śayyāmāroḍhumiccatyalasagāminī ।triṣulokeṣu cānyā me na sītāsadṛśī matā ॥6-12-13॥।।

translations.english: "Sita who walks modestly did not like to enter into my bed (love me ) however much I prayed. I do not think there is anyone who looks like her in the three worlds."
translations.hindi: नाट--रावण्‌ सब के सामने यह स्पष्ट रूप से नहीं कहता कि, मैं दए्डक वन से सीता के बरजारी हर लाया हूँ। वह कहता हे ““्रानीता” अर्थात्‌ ले आया हूँ । ] तु सा मे न शय्यामारोढमिच्छत्यलसगामिनी । त्रिष लोकेष दान्या मे न सीतासदृशी मत्ता

verses.sloka: तनुमध्या पृथुश्रोणी शरदिन्दुनिभानना ।हेमबिम्बनिभा सौम्यामायेव मयनिर्मिता ॥६-१२-१४॥।।
verses.transliteration: tanumadhyā pṛthuśroṇī śaradindunibhānanā ।hemabimbanibhā saumyāmāyeva mayanirmitā ॥6-12-14॥।।

translations.english: "She is a woman of slender waist, plump hips, whose face is like an autumnal full moon. She is gentle and like a golden image. She is like a magical one constructed by Maya."
translations.hindi: समर्थवित्र--ज्ञापयित । ( गो० ) २ अऋलसगामिनी--मन्द्‌- गामित्री | ( गो० ) ६२ युद्धकाण्डे तनुमध्या प्रथृश्रोशी शारदेन्दुनिभानना । हेम विम्वनिभा सौम्या मायेत्र मंयनिर्मिता |! १४ ॥ क्योंकि उसकी पतली कमर है. मोटी जाँच है, शारदूऋलु के चन्द्रमा जेसा उसका सुख है । सुवण प्रतिमातुल्य, वह मय निर्मित माया की तरह (मन को मोहने वाली हे)

verses.sloka: सुलोहिततलौ श्लक्क्षणौ चरणौ सुप्रतिष्ठतौ ।दृष्ट्वा ताम्रनखौ तस्या दीप्यते मे शरीरजः ॥६-१२-१५॥।।
verses.transliteration: sulohitatalau ślakkṣaṇau caraṇau supratiṣṭhatau ।dṛṣṭvā tāmranakhau tasyā dīpyate me śarīrajaḥ ॥6-12-15॥।।

translations.english: "Beholding her smooth red soles and evenly shaped pinkish nails of feet, love is kindled in me."

verses.sloka: हुताग्निरर्चिःसम्काशामेनाम् सौरीमिव प्रभाम् ।उन्नसम् विमलम् वल्गु वदनम् चारुलोचनम् ॥६-१२-१६॥।।
verses.transliteration: hutāgnirarciḥsamkāśāmenām saurīmiva prabhām ।unnasam vimalam valgu vadanam cārulocanam ॥6-12-16॥।।

translations.english: "On beholding the sacrificial firelike face of Sita glowing like the radiance of the Sun, seeing her prominent nose, her large attractive countenance with beautiful eyes surely, I am overtaken by love and have become a slave to her."
translations.hindi: हवन वी प्रज्वलित आग अथवा सूर्य की प्रभा को तरह विशाल नयनी सोता वो देख सैं काम के वश में हो गया हू

verses.sloka: पश्यम्स्तदवशस्तस्याः कामस्य वशमेयिवान् ।क्रोधहर्षसमानेन दुर्वर्णकरणेन च ॥६-१२-१७॥।।
verses.transliteration: paśyamstadavaśastasyāḥ kāmasya vaśameyivān ।krodhaharṣasamānena durvarṇakaraṇena ca ॥6-12-17॥।।

translations.english: "I have been disturbed by passion, which is equal in anger or happiness and makes one pale in grief or agony."
translations.hindi: सीता दी उँची नाक और उसके मनोहर नेत्रों से सुशोभित मुख मण्डल को देख जें काम के वशवर्ती हो, उस (सीत) के ` खघीन हो गया हूँ

verses.sloka: शोकसम्तापनित्येन कामेन कलुषीकृतः ।सा तु सम्वत्सरम् कालम् मामयाचत भामिनी ॥६-१२-१८॥।।
verses.transliteration: śokasamtāpanityena kāmena kaluṣīkṛtaḥ ।sā tu samvatsaram kālam māmayācata bhāminī ॥6-12-18॥।।

translations.english: "Broadeyed Sita requested me one year time expecting her husband Rama to come (this is a false statement made by Ravana here) and I promised in turn to Sita of beautiful eyes. Just like an exhausted horse that marched I am tired on account of my passion."

verses.sloka: प्रतीक्षमाणा भर्तारम् राममायतलोचना ।तन्मया चारुनेत्रायाः प्रतिज्ञातम् वचः शुभम् ॥६-१२-१९॥।।
verses.transliteration: pratīkṣamāṇā bhartāram rāmamāyatalocanā ।tanmayā cārunetrāyāḥ pratijñātam vacaḥ śubham ॥6-12-19॥।।

translations.english: "Broadeyed Sita requested me one year time expecting her husband Rama to come (this is a false statement made by Ravana here) and I promised in turn to Sita of beautiful eyes. Just like an exhausted horse that marched I am tired on account of my passion."

verses.sloka: श्रान्तोऽहम् सततम् कामाद्यातो हय इवाध्वनि ।कथम् सागरमक्षोभ्यम् तरिष्यन्ति वनौकसः ॥६-१२-२०॥।।
verses.transliteration: śrānto'ham satatam kāmādyāto haya ivādhvani ।katham sāgaramakṣobhyam tariṣyanti vanaukasaḥ ॥6-12-20॥।।

translations.english: "How will the Vanaras and even both the sons of Dasaratha be able to cross the unassailable ocean inhabited by huge crocodiles?"
translations.hindi: सो उस सुन्दर चेत्र वाली से मैं सत्यप्रतिज्ञा कर चुका हूँ । किन्तु निरन्तर की कामपीड़ा से मैं वैसे ही शान्त हो गया हूँ जैसे-बहुत दूर चला हुआ घोड़ा थक जाता है

verses.sloka: बहुसत्त्वसमाकीर्णम् तौ वा दशरथात्मजौ ।अथवा कपिनैकेन कृतम् नः कदनम् महत् ॥६-१२-२१॥।।
verses.transliteration: bahusattvasamākīrṇam tau vā daśarathātmajau ।athavā kapinaikena kṛtam naḥ kadanam mahat ॥6-12-21॥।।

translations.english: "Even so, a huge destruction was done to us, by a single monkey. The consequences of their acts are unpredictable. Tell me what is there in your mind, according to your own understanding."
translations.hindi: परन्तु उपाय का अवलंबन किए बिना जो काम मनमाने उल्टे सीधे किए जाते हैं, वे सब उसो प्रकार दूषित होते हैं, जिस प्रकार अपवित्र हव्य की आहति

verses.sloka: दुर्ज्ञेयाः कार्यगतयो ब्रूत यस्य यथामति ।मानुषान्नो भयम् नास्ति तथापि तु विमृश्यताम् ॥६-१२-२२॥।।
verses.transliteration: durjñeyāḥ kāryagatayo brūta yasya yathāmati ।mānuṣānno bhayam nāsti tathāpi tu vimṛśyatām ॥6-12-22॥।।

translations.english: "There is no fear of human beings for me. I won the war between Devas and asuras along with you. As it is, all of you are there. There at the shore of the ocean Rama and Lakshmana have collected with Sugriva and other leaders placing Vanaras in front to get back Sita. You may suggest a way out to gain."
translations.hindi: साथ ही यह भी विचार उत्पन्न होता है कि, जब एक ही वानर ने इतना बड़ा मेरा अपमान और मेरी सेना कां नाश कर डाला * प [ठान्तरे = 3 तरन्ति |? ६४ युद्धकाण्डे तब उनके कार्यक्रम का जानता कठिन हे \ अन आप लोग जैसा आपकी समझ में आवे, वेसा कहे

verses.sloka: तदा देवासुरे युद्दे युष्माभिः सहितोऽजयम् ।ते मे भवन्तश्च तथा सुग्रीवप्रमुखान् हरीन् ॥६-१२-२३॥।।
verses.transliteration: tadā devāsure yudde yuṣmābhiḥ sahito'jayam ।te me bhavantaśca tathā sugrīvapramukhān harīn ॥6-12-23॥।।

translations.english: "There is no fear of human beings for me. I won the war between Devas and asuras along with you. As it is, all of you are there. There at the shore of the ocean Rama and Lakshmana have collected with Sugriva and other leaders placing Vanaras in front to get back Sita. You may suggest a way out to gain."
translations.hindi: यद्यपि हम लोगों को मनुष्यजाति से डर नहीं हें, तथापि विचार करना उचित दै । मैंने पहिले देवासुर संग्राम से तुम लोगों की सहायता से ही विजय पाया था

verses.sloka: परे पारे समुद्रस्य पुरस्कृत्य नृपात्मजौ ।सीतायाः पदवीम् प्राप्य सम्प्राप्तौ वरुणालयम् ॥६-१२-२४॥।।
verses.transliteration: pare pāre samudrasya puraskṛtya nṛpātmajau ।sītāyāḥ padavīm prāpya samprāptau varuṇālayam ॥6-12-24॥।।

translations.english: "There is no fear of human beings for me. I won the war between Devas and asuras along with you. As it is, all of you are there. There at the shore of the ocean Rama and Lakshmana have collected with Sugriva and other leaders placing Vanaras in front to get back Sita. You may suggest a way out to gain."
translations.hindi: अतः अब उपस्थित कार्यं सें भी आप लोग सहायता करें थी यह भी समाचार मिला है कि, सुग्रीव आदि वानर और वे दोनों वीर राजकुमार समुद्र के उस पार आ पु चे हें

verses.sloka: अदेया च यथा सीता वध्यौ दशरथात्मजौ ।भवद्भिर्मन्त्य्रताम् मन्त्रः सुनीतम् चाभिधीयताम् ॥६-१२-२५॥।।
verses.transliteration: adeyā ca yathā sītā vadhyau daśarathātmajau ।bhavadbhirmantyratām mantraḥ sunītam cābhidhīyatām ॥6-12-25॥।।

translations.english: "You may also think over and suggest to me a plan to kill Rama and Lakshmana without giving Sita."
translations.hindi: वे सीता के यहाँ होने का समाचार पा कर ही समुद्रतट पर आए हैं । सीता तो देना न पड़े और वे दोनों राजकुमार मारे लाँय

verses.sloka: न हि शक्तिम् प्रपश्यामि जगत्यन्यस्य कस्यचित् ।सागरम् वानरैस्तीर्त्वा विश्चयेन जयो मम ॥६-१२-२६॥।।
verses.transliteration: na hi śaktim prapaśyāmi jagatyanyasya kasyacit ।sāgaram vānaraistīrtvā viścayena jayo mama ॥6-12-26॥।।

translations.english: "No one can cross the ocean with Vanaras (help). As such I do not find anyone has the capacity. I am certain of victory."
translations.hindi: इस विषय में आप लोग त्रिचार लें और भली प्रकार से निश्चय कर निश्चित बात बतलावें । मैं तो इस संसार में दूसरे किसी में र = १ सुनीत-सुनिश्चित। ( रा० ) यया... I किसी में ऐसी शक्ति नहीं देखता कि वानरों के साथ समुद्र के इस पारा सके | फिर जीत तो मरी निश्चित ही है

verses.sloka: तस्य कामपरीतस्य निशम्य परिदेवितम् ।कुम्भकर्णः प्रचुक्रोध वचनम् चेदमब्रवीत् ॥६-१२-२७॥।।
verses.transliteration: tasya kāmaparītasya niśamya paridevitam ।kumbhakarṇaḥ pracukrodha vacanam cedamabravīt ॥6-12-27॥।।

translations.english: On hearing the lamentation of Ravana seized with passion, enraged Kumbhakarna uttered these words.
translations.hindi: कामासक्त होते के कारण रावण की बुद्धि बिगड्‌ गई थी-- सो उसकी ये उल्टी पुस्टी बातें सुन, कुम्मकण को बड़ा क्रोध चढ़ आया ओर वह बैसी ही अटपटी बातें कहने लगा

verses.sloka: यदा तु रामस्य सलक्ष्मणस्य ।प्रसह्य सीता खलु पा इहाऽहृता ।सकृत्समीक्षैव सुनिश्चितम् तदा ।भजेत चित्तम् यमुनेव यामुनम् ॥६-१२-२८॥।।
verses.transliteration: yadā tu rāmasya salakṣmaṇasya ।prasahya sītā khalu pā ihā'hṛtā ।sakṛtsamīkṣaiva suniścitam tadā ।bhajeta cittam yamuneva yāmunam ॥6-12-28॥।।

translations.english: "If you had at that time, that is before bringing Sita by force, which was accompanied by Rama and Lakshmana, discussed, and thought of, then you would be sure in your mind like the Yamuna River filling the Yamuna (mountain )."

verses.sloka: सर्वमेतन्महाराज कृतमप्रतिमम् तव ।विधीयेत सहास्माभिरादावेवास्य कर्मणः ॥६-१२-२९॥।।
verses.transliteration: sarvametanmahārāja kṛtamapratimam tava ।vidhīyeta sahāsmābhirādāvevāsya karmaṇaḥ ॥6-12-29॥।।

translations.english: "Great king If you had discussed with us about all this action earlier, it would have been very good."

verses.sloka: न्यायेन राजकार्याणि यः करोति दशानन ।न स सम्तप्यते पश्चान्निश्चतार्थमतिर्नृपः ॥६-१२-३०॥।।
verses.transliteration: nyāyena rājakāryāṇi yaḥ karoti daśānana ।na sa samtapyate paścānniścatārthamatirnṛpaḥ ॥6-12-30॥।।

translations.english: "O Ravana Whoever is the king, having a sense of determination, thinks justifiably and carries out princely duties will not regret."
translations.hindi: हे दशानन ! जो राजा विचारपूर्वक काम करता हैं, उसको ` पीछे कभी सन्ताप नहीं होता, क्योंकि शास्त्रानुसार वह अपची बुद्धि से उसका निश्चय कर लेता है,

verses.sloka: अनुपायेन कर्माणि विपरीतानि यानि च ।क्रियमाणानि दुष्यन्ति हवीम्ष्यप्रयतेष्विन ॥६-१२-३१॥।।
verses.transliteration: anupāyena karmāṇi viparītāni yāni ca ।kriyamāṇāni duṣyanti havīmṣyaprayateṣvina ॥6-12-31॥।।

translations.english: "Tasks carried out without proper plan and contrary to the right principles are spoilt like inauspicious oblations offered into sacrificial fire."

verses.sloka: यः पश्चात्पूर्वकार्याणि कर्माण्यभिचिकीर्षति ।पूर्वम् चापरकर्याणि न स वेद नयानयौ ॥६-१२-३२॥।।
verses.transliteration: yaḥ paścātpūrvakāryāṇi karmāṇyabhicikīrṣati ।pūrvam cāparakaryāṇi na sa veda nayānayau ॥6-12-32॥।।

translations.english: "He who seeks to perform earlier what has to be done later and does later what have to be done earlier is not a knower of right and wrong."

verses.sloka: चपलस्य तु कृत्येषु प्रसमीक्स्याधिकम् बलम् ।चिद्रमन्ये प्रपद्यन्ते क्रौञ्चस्य खमिव द्विजाः ॥६-१२-३३॥।।
verses.transliteration: capalasya tu kṛtyeṣu prasamīksyādhikam balam ।cidramanye prapadyante krauñcasya khamiva dvijāḥ ॥6-12-33॥।।

translations.english: A hasty one who acts without thinking of the superior strength (of enemy) gets out at once like the swan penetrates into the crevice of Krauncha (mountain).
translations.hindi: जो चंचल स्वंभाव के लोग होते हैं उनके कामों में उनके शत्रु बसे ही छिद्र ढं,ह़ा करते हैं, जैसे क्रॉंच पर्वत के छिद्र, हंस ढढ़ते हैं

verses.sloka: त्वयेदम् महादारभम् कार्य मप्रतिचिन्तितम् ।दिष्ट्या त्वाम् नावधीद्रामो विषमिश्रमिवामृतम् ॥६-१२-३४॥।।
verses.transliteration: tvayedam mahādārabham kārya mapraticintitam ।diṣṭyā tvām nāvadhīdrāmo viṣamiśramivāmṛtam ॥6-12-34॥।।

translations.english: "Without prior thought this great act has been done by you. Rama has not killed you, fortunately like poison mixed flesh would kill."
translations.hindi: हे अनघ ! जब कि, तुमने इस अनुचित काय को कर सम- चन्द्र के साथ शत्रुता कर ली है, तव मैं ही तुम्हारे शत्रुओं को मार कर, इसे ठीक करू गा

verses.sloka: तस्मात्त्वया समारब्धम् कर्म ह्यप्रतिमम् परैः ।अहम् समीकरिष्यामि हत्वा शत्रूम् स्तनानघ ॥६-१२-३५॥।।
verses.transliteration: tasmāttvayā samārabdham karma hyapratimam paraiḥ ।aham samīkariṣyāmi hatvā śatrūm stanānagha ॥6-12-35॥।।

translations.english: "O Sinless Ravana Therefore, that which you have done is not possible for none other than me. I will kill your enemy and accomplish your goal for you."

verses.sloka: अहमुत्सादयिष्यामि शत्रूम्स्तव निशाचर ।यदि शक्रविवस्वन्तौ यदि पावकमारुतौ ॥६-१२-३६॥।।
verses.transliteration: ahamutsādayiṣyāmi śatrūmstava niśācara ।yadi śakravivasvantau yadi pāvakamārutau ॥6-12-36॥।।

translations.english: "O Rakshasa I will ruin the enemy. I will fight with both of them (Rama and Lakshmana) even if they are Indra and sun, fire god and wind god or Kubera and Varuna."

verses.sloka: तावहम् योधयिष्यामि कुबेरवरुणावपि ।गिरिमात्रशरीरस्य महापरिघयोधिनः ॥६-१२-३७॥।।
verses.transliteration: tāvaham yodhayiṣyāmi kuberavaruṇāvapi ।girimātraśarīrasya mahāparighayodhinaḥ ॥6-12-37॥।।

translations.english: "If I go with a mountain like body and sharp teeth, holding a huge iron bar roaring like a lion, even Indra will run away out of fear."
translations.hindi: मेरा पर्वताकार शरीर है, पैता त्रिशूल मेरा आयुध है ] पेने पेने मेरे दाँत हूं । मैं जब रणाक्षेत्र में खड़ा हो गर्जना करू गा, तब इन्द्र भी भयभीत हो जाँयगे

verses.sloka: नर्दतस्तीक्ष्णदम्ष्ट्रस्य बिभीयाद्वै पुरन्दरः ।पुनर्माम् सद्वितीयेन शरेण निहनिष्यति ॥६-१२-३८॥।।
verses.transliteration: nardatastīkṣṇadamṣṭrasya bibhīyādvai purandaraḥ ।punarmām sadvitīyena śareṇa nihaniṣyati ॥6-12-38॥।।

translations.english: "By the time he releases a second arrow again, I will immediately drink his blood. Stay quiet with confidence."

verses.sloka: ततोऽहम् तस्य पास्यामि रुधिरम् काममाश्वस ।वधेव वै दाशरथेह् सुखावहम् ।जयम् तवाहर्तुमहम् तयिष्ये ।हत्वा च रामम् सह लक्ष्मणेन ।खादामि सर्वान् हरियूथमुख्यान् ॥६-१२-३९॥।।
verses.transliteration: tato'ham tasya pāsyāmi rudhiram kāmamāśvasa ।vadheva vai dāśaratheh sukhāvaham ।jayam tavāhartumaham tayiṣye ।hatvā ca rāmam saha lakṣmaṇena ।khādāmi sarvān hariyūthamukhyān ॥6-12-39॥।।

translations.english: "By killing Rama, I will try to make you happy and victorious. On killing Rama and Lakshmana like that I will consume the Vanara leaders."

verses.sloka: रमस्व कामम् पिब चाग्र्यवारुणीम् ।कुरुष्व कार्वाणि हितानि विज्वरः ।मया तु रामे गमिते यमक्षयम् ।चिराय सीता वशगा भविष्यति ॥६-१२-४०॥
verses.transliteration: ramasva kāmam piba cāgryavāruṇīm ।kuruṣva kārvāṇi hitāni vijvaraḥ ।mayā tu rāme gamite yamakṣayam ।cirāya sītā vaśagā bhaviṣyati ॥6-12-40॥

translations.english: "You be free from fear, sporting and drinking the best of wines and doing actions that you like. Rama will be sent to the abode of the god of death. On reaching their Sita will be under your control for long." ।।इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेद्वादशस्सर्गः।। This is the end of twelfth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
translations.hindi: जब मैं राम को यमालय भेज दूंगा, तब सीता, सदा के लिए तुम्हारे वश हो जायगी
